selection.strategy: continue automatically after Amsterdam and closure review; complexity-first triage

findings: Current official policy explicitly distinguishes one-household occupation from kamerverhuur and permanent dwelling splitting in the pre-mantelzorg context.
No dedicated current Huisvestingsverordening/opkoopbescherming regime was established in this first pass; address-level omgevingsplan review remains necessary for ordinary room rental/splitting.
The Huisvestingsverordening Baarn 2023 is officially marked expired as of 2025-11-03.
It must not be used as current 2026 law. A successor/current framework must be located before legal conclusions are produced.
Official search results show a Barendrecht housing-related regulation that ended 2025-06-30; expired material must not be treated as 2026 law.
Older regional housing-stock rules include Barendrecht in their regional definitions, but current municipality-specific applicability requires a fresh 2026 source check.
Huisvestingsverordening gemeente Barneveld 2024-2028 is officially marked expired as of 2025-04-29 despite its title suggesting a later horizon.
This is a high-value staleness trap: the title alone must never be used to infer validity. Current successor rules must be located before product use.

qaLessons: Always validate effective/expiry dates independently of regulation title.
Do not inherit regional rules without confirming current municipality applicability.
An expired housing ordinance automatically triggers successor-source discovery rather than a no-rule conclusion.
